webhooks_list_subscriptions.description: Lists the workspace's webhook subscriptions, each annotated with its most recent delivery attempt (if any). Read-only.

webhooks_get_deliveries.description: Fetches the delivery log (status, attempts, last response, timestamps) for one webhook subscription, newest first.

subscriptionId.description: A webhook subscription's id, as returned by webhooks_create_subscription or content_read.webhook_subscription.

limit.description: Max rows to return, newest first. Defaults to 50; capped at 200 regardless of what is requested.

How many times has this webhook retried?

webhooks_create_subscription.description: Creates a new webhook subscription. Starts active at signing-secret generation 1 — the signing secret itself is never generated or exposed by this tool (it is derived at delivery time from the install site key, never stored).

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the admin UI.

targetUrl.description: The absolute https:// URL deliveries are POSTed to. Must be https and must resolve against this workspace's egress allowlist, or the write is refused.

topics.description: Event topics this subscription matches (e.g. 'post.published'). At least one is required; blanks are dropped and duplicates de-duplicated. A trailing '.*' matches every action for an entity.

webhooks_update_subscription.description: Replaces a webhook subscription's label, HTTPS targetUrl and topics by subscriptionId. Supply all three fields; use content_read.webhook_subscription to read current values first. Returns {subscription}, with signing version metadata but no secret. Status and signing generation stay unchanged. Missing ids, empty labels/topics, malformed targets, denied permission and disallowed egress are refused. Requires admin.integrations.manage. Pass expectedVersion from content_read.webhook_subscription; if someone changed it since, nothing is saved and you must re-read.

expectedVersion.description: The record's version from content_read.webhook_subscription. Required.

search.keywords: webhook subscription edit update label target url topics endpoint

webhooks_pause_subscription.description: Pauses or resumes a webhook subscription's deliveries. One tool, both directions (paused defaults to true). Refused if the subscription is already deleted (disabled).

subscriptionId.description: A webhook subscription's id, as returned by webhooks_create_subscription or content_read.webhook_subscription.

paused.description: true (default) pauses delivery; false resumes an already-paused subscription back to active. Cannot resume a deleted (disabled) subscription.

search.keywords: webhook webhooks pause stop disable suspend integration
queries: Can you pause this webhook so it stops sending?
How do I temporarily stop an integration from firing?

webhooks_delete_subscription.description: Soft-deletes a webhook subscription (never row-deleted, for audit durability). Safe to call again on an already-deleted subscription — it does not error, though disabledAt/updatedAt are stamped again.

subscriptionId.description: A webhook subscription's id, as returned by webhooks_create_subscription or content_read.webhook_subscription.

metadata.summary: This permanently removes the selected webhook subscription and stops its deliveries.
